text:
DeployBot: Deploy wave v1.12.0 -> prod (us-west-2) started. Canary 10% rolling now.
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated p95/p99 latency and 5xx rate on /v1/generate (since +2m). Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
Sara: seeing tail latency jump to ~1.2s from 180ms. 5xx ~0.8% -> 3.2%. Canary only? not universal yet.
Matt: checking canary hosts now. quick grep in logs shows repeated kernel fallback on several allocs: 
```
[2026-06-10T14:02:10Z] kernel_fallback: selected cpu_scalar for aten::matmul; reason=quantized_path_missing
[2026-06-10T14:02:11Z] batcher: dropped_to_sync_mode=true; batch_size=1
```

Matt: looks like the new batcher + kernel combo falls back to slower scalar code path under certain seq lengths.
Priya: tagging @DeployBot-configs and @Alex for immediate mitigation. Is kill-switch available for the new batcher?
Alex: yes, feature flag is `runtime.new_batcher_v2` and we have a rollout kill: `rollout.kill.v1.12.0=true`.
Priya: ok flip kill-switch. I'll coordinate rollback if that doesn't stabilize within 5m.
Emily: notifying CS/ops: subject="Prod latency spike — potential impact on realtime partners". Drafting short note.
DeployBot: kill-switch toggled: `rollout.kill.v1.12.0=true` (by Priya). Canary traffic now shifting back to v1.11.9.
Sara: after kill-switch flip p95 dropped to ~250ms and 5xx down to 0.9%. Partial improvement.
Matt: digging deeper — kernel selection log shows fallback triggered when batcher emits a single-example path and a quantized kernel wasn't available for the specific model shape. Possible regression in kernel registry or new batcher changes to sequence padding.
Matt: repro steps locally: run ./bench --model rdx-meduim --seq 1024 --batcher=new_v2 -> see cpu_scalar fallback.
```
# quick repro
./bench --model rdx-medium --seq 1024 --batcher=new_v2 --device=gpu
# observe kernel_fallback entries
```

Alex: sounds like two mitigations: 1) keep kill-switch / rollback for now, 2) patch kernel registry or make batcher request compatible kernel family. Which do we want first?
Priya: immediate priority = stable prod. Keep kill-switch and finish rollback to v1.11.9 for full fleet. Matt/Alex, create a hotpatch branch for kernel registry fix, mark as hotfix candidate.
Emily: CS note sent: "We observed increased latency for a subset of generation traffic during a canary rollout. We reverted the rollout and have mitigations in place. No ongoing customer impact." Will update if anything changes.
DeployBot: Rollback initiated: wave -> v1.11.9. Estimated completion 3m.
Sara: monitoring: p95 returning to baseline ~180ms; tail still settling.
Matt: created PR #4627 for kernel-registry fallback check + unit test. Marking as hotpatch.
Alex: after rollback, confirm batcher_v1 remains default; ensure automations prevent immediate re-rollout to v1.12.0 until fix merged.
Priya: putting hold on v1.12.0 in rollout automation and setting a manual gate. Also creating incident channel for postmortem.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: customer impact assessed as limited (canary fraction only), but risk to broader rollout warranted P1. Postmortem owner: Matt.
Emily: coordinating follow-up comms and internal RCA note for execs.
Sara: closing monitoring loop, no further alerts in last 4m.
Alex: summary: root cause = new_batcher_v2 interaction with kernel registry leading to scalar fallback for certain seq lengths -> regression in tail latency. Action items: revert by default, hotpatch kernel registry, add regression test harness for batcher+kernel combinations, add rollout guard to verify p99 before global rollout.
Priya: handoff to postmortem owner Matt. I'll update oncall rotation notes.
Matt: thanks — will own postmortem and include test plan + timeline for hotfix.
Emily: scheduling customer follow-ups and release notes hold.
DeployBot: Incident marked resolved by Priya. Keep channel for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
